apps.name: LocalDevVPN
apps.subtitle: Local VPN tunnel with /32 peer route fix
apps.versionDescription: Custom build adding a /32 route for the fake peer IP so an in-WiFi-subnet peer stays reachable through the utun tunnel (required by the iOS 26.4+ lockdown source-IP check).
apps.localizedDescription: Custom LocalDevVPN build with the /32 peer route fix for iOS 26.4+ lockdown. When installing in SideStore choose "Keep App Extensions (Use Main Profile)" so only one App ID is used.
